The '''mudwasp''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of creature that lived in nests. The [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] was similar to a mudwasp's nest, due to the many vehicles hovering around at all times.<ref name="TF">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref>
